create_picture_description_factory: create a PictureDescriptionFactory instance with plugin_attr_name and optional plugin_name
build_picture_description_model: build a PictureDescriptionBaseModel instance with enabled, enable_remote_services, artifacts_path, options, and accelerator_options
register_picture_description_class: register a picture description class with the factory using options type, plugin_name, and plugin_module_name
load_picture_description_plugins: load picture description plugin classes from setuptools entrypoints into the factory
create_picture_description_instance: create a picture description model instance from options and kwargs via the factory
